name: Bard College Berlin
summary: Liberal arts college in Berlin teaching in English; three 4-year BAs, each giving qualifying students a German and a US degree.

ib.text: The German BA needs an IB that meets Germany's KMK rule (six set subject groups, each at 4, 24 points); BCB publishes it as an IB sheet. English at C1, waived after a year of English-taught school.

apply.via: Common App or BCB's own online form

dates.label: Early Action: application and financial aid application due
Regular Decision deadline; also registration for the Berlin Immediate Decision day
Immediate Decision Plan day in Berlin (apply face to face)
Final application deadline for EU/EEA citizens and residents

programmes.name: BA in Economics, Politics, and Social Thought
programmes.ib: No German needed to apply; you must show intermediate German by the end of year two.

programmes.name: BA in Humanities, the Arts, and Social Thought
programmes.ib: No German needed to apply; you must show intermediate German by the end of year two.

programmes.name: BA in Artistic Practice and Society
programmes.ib: Art samples required. No German needed to apply; you must show intermediate German by the end of year two.

notes: There is no application fee; you send a motivation statement, a graded English essay written for a class and at least two academic references.
If your IB does not meet Germany's recognition rule you can still earn the US BA, which BCB grants on the basis of your national school diploma.
The 2026/27 comprehensive fee is €38,250 on campus or €27,500 off campus, and BCB says nearly 80 percent of students receive some financial help.
